title: [Decision] Console home blocks registered without a namespace: raise the namespaced ratchet, arm twins, or leave bare
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from the os-dev report on PR #13300 (objectui#13295, item 2). ⛔ Not a claim. The other two items of objectui#13295 are handled in PR #13300; this card carries item 2 alone.

**Reader (who acts):** the maintainer (or the director seat) picks a route; then the objectui `domain:ui` lane applies it.

## What

`packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/productBlocks.tsx` registers five console home blocks (`hero`, `stat`, `usage-bar`, `checklist`, `tile-grid`) with no `namespace`. `packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts` (~529) logs `Registering component "…" without a namespace is deprecated` for each, on every console boot. That was found on cloud staging (objectstack-ai/cloud#3125) and is still present on objectui `main` (measured at `0093b2c826`).

The ruled fix, `namespace: 'app-shell'` (the namespace every other console registration uses), works at runtime: a bare `type: 'hero'` still renders, `app-shell:hero` renders, and no warning is logged. But regenerating `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` then adds five `app-shell:` keys that `objectui validate` refuses at `type`. That raises `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` in `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` from 302 to 307.

**Governing text:** `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` header: "⛔ It never rises … ⛔ Do not raise the constant to make it pass — arm the type, or take the registration's authorability to the card." The same file records one earlier "named stopgap raise" by seat answer (6116842485). Raising a gate's pin is a weakening, so the seat does not grant it on its own.

## Options

| | Route | Effort |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Namespace the five calls and arm the five `app-shell:` twins in `@object-ui/types` (`product-blocks.zod.ts`), so validate accepts both spellings. | ~half a day; outside a UI-only surface (types zod, TS face, parity gates) |
| **B** (dev's recommendation) | Namespace the five calls, regenerate `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, and raise the pin 302 → 307 as a named stopgap with a comment naming this card. The diff is ready (5 namespace lines, 5 generated keys, the pin, a pin test). | ~15 minutes |
| **C** | Leave the registrations bare and close the item as won't-fix (devtools noise only), or move it to a Registry policy that does not warn for a bare key that is the spec's own page-vocabulary spelling. | 0 now; the Registry policy change touches `packages/core` and every bare registration |

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**:可观测的症状只是每次控制台启动打印的 5 条弃用告警,用户界面无影响。没有人写 `app-shell:hero`:所有页面和预览画廊都写裸 `hero`。A 的双拼写无实测生产者;B 与 C 都不改变作者面。
- **项目长远合理性**:B 让这五个注册与其余 `app-shell:` 注册(已在 302 之内)同形,但用一次「永不上升」棘轮的上调换取;C 认为裸 `hero` 本就是规范的页面词汇拼写(ADR-0060),告警本身才是该改的地方,但那是 `packages/core` 的策略改动;A 引入第二种可写拼写,与 contract-first 相悖。
- **防 AI 写错**:B 保持唯一可写拼写 `hero`,`app-shell:hero` 在 validate 处被响亮拒绝;C 中性;A 最差,让 AI 两种拼写都能写。
- **创业阶段不扩散**:B 与 C 都不扩面;A 无拉动地扩面。B 需要豁免一条「永不上升」的门禁规则,门禁只减不增的方向上属于放松,故交维护者。

**Seat view:** B or C. B removes the observed symptom at the cost of a named, five-key stopgap raise. C is zero-cost and arguably more faithful to the spec's bare page vocabulary, but leaves the warnings. A is not recommended.
